sentences.text: For the petitioner  rt : Mr. Vaibhav Tanwar, Advocate.

For the respondent :
 Ms. Priyanka Chauhan, Deputy  Advocate General.
In terms of previous order dated 20.10.2023, learned Deputy Advocate General explained exigencies, whereby the respondents could not be present in the Court due to some communication gap.

However, learned Deputy Advocate General has placed on record instructions dated 09.11.2023 (taken on record), relevant portion whereof reads as under:-
"This is in reference to your Office Letter No.HPSEBL (Sectt/)GE/101 13/Court Cases/2023 dated 3.11.2023 on th subject cited above and to say that the proceeding Sh. Anil Tanwar vs Sh. Hem Raj Bairwa on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162625007/
1 as envisaged under the Himachal Pradesh right to Fair Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
